title.value: Technology-enhanced trauma training in low-resource settings: A scoping review and feasibility analysis of educational technologies
title.justification: The title of the paper is mentioned at the beginning of the document and clearly outlines the focus of the study.
title.quote: Technology-enhanced trauma training in low-resource settings: A scoping review and feasibility analysis of educational technologies

extractions.description: This paper reviews current educational technologies used in trauma courses and evaluates their feasibility for usage in low- and lower-middle-income countries (LMICs). The study focuses on technology-enhanced training methods to improve trauma training in these regions, identifying challenges and potential solutions for effective training.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is improving trauma training in low-resource settings using educational technologies, which is not directly related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This is the first study to perform a feasibility analysis of trauma training technologies in the LMIC context.
